title: Test: computeNextEligible adds the interval in milliseconds
description: computeNextEligible must convert minutes to milliseconds and add exactly, no off-by-one.
acceptance_criteria: @Test fun computeNextEligible_addsIntervalInMillis() calls DoseTimingCalculator.computeNextEligible(1_000_000L, 60) and asserts the result equals 1_000_000L + 60 * 60_000L via assertEquals
